title: Aaron
summary: Elder brother of Moses, born three years before him (Exod 7:7); first high priest; died on Mount Hor aged 123 (Num 33:38-39).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 4: Ussher, Annals (1658): 1574 BC (no higher-tier year available).

birth.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002). Leave empty until verified.

birth.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Third Age §160 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
birth.note: "Aaron was born 3 years before his brother Moses, 83 years before the departure of the Israelites from Egypt. Ex 7:7"

birth.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 5)," Biblical Chronology 6:7 (July 1994), §15 "Moses" (year list)

death.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002). Leave empty until verified.

death.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Fourth Age §268 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
death.note: §267 (34th camp, Mount Hor) and §268: "The Israelites mourned for Aaron 30 days".

death.date: Then Aaron died. Numbers 33:38 says that he died on the 1st day of the 5th month.
death.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 6)," Biblical Chronology 6:8 (August 1994), §18 "The Years 2553 and 2554."
death.note: Jordan's year 2553 begins in month 7 (autumn), so his month 5 of 2553 is the same summer as Ussher's 2552c AM / 1452 BC.
